title: Happiness house
description:
An incredible home offering the perfect family getaway! Come and enjoy a truly exceptional experience at our property, featuring plenty of fun activities to do and share. This completely renovated house boasts a breakfast area and living spaces designed for everyone's enjoyment. We feature a game room, four comfortable bedrooms where you can rest and recharge, and a beautiful patio where you can admire the sunsets, host a barbecue, enjoy the fresh air, or simply hang out!

The space
Discover our charming home, designed to offer you comfort and fun in every corner. Our house features 4 cozy bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, spread across two floors to ensure everyone has their own space.

On the ground floor:
- Master bedroom with a king-size bed for a restful night's sleep
- 2 bedrooms with queen-size beds for added comfort
- Fully equipped kitchen for preparing delicious family meals
- Dining and living areas for enjoying unforgettable moments
- Game room for endless fun

On the upper floor:
- Family bedroom with 2 queen-size beds and a sofa bed with 2 twin mattresses for extra space

Plus, enjoy our beautiful patio and parking space for up to 4 vehicles.
Make your stay an unforgettable experience! 😊
